points.description: States that the * operator returns an alias (synonym) for the object its operand points to, i.e. the name/lvalue through which that object in memory can be accessed. Equivalent wording such as 'the object/variable at the pointed-to address, usable as a name for it' earns the mark. The phrase 'in memory' is not required.
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if the student says the operator gives the object (or value) the pointer points to, but does not say it is an alias, synonym or name for that object.

points.description: States that the operator is the dereferencing (indirection) operator.
